title: fragariastrum brachypetalum
intro: Fragariastrum brachypetalum, commonly known as the strawberry tree, is a type of flowering plant in the heath family. This plant is native to the Mediterranean region and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Fragariastrum brachypetalum include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties.
